newsitem.title: UK: UK Environment Agency warns hosepipe bans possible.
newsitem.headline: UK Environment Agency warns hosepipe bans possible.

text.p: Britain's Environment Agency said on Tuesday that hosepipe bans and other restrictions on water use may be needed in the south-east and east of England this year because of low groundwater levels.

The agency said groundwater levels were low because of the long period of dry weather between April 1995 and January 1997. The agency said 360mm less rain than average fell in England and Wales in that period, equivalent to missing four months of winter rainfall.
The Environment Agency said water companies were being asked to submit plans on how they intended to manage water resources during the summer.
